correctness.rationale: The exact 38-edge 19-vertex graph is supplied. Every subset of sizes 1,2,3 is enumerated (19+171+969); simultaneous power propagation halts on full coverage or a fixed point. The only minimum successes are 753 triples with completion-time counts (109,320,204,120). Both independently implemented checkers generate the 753-state exchange and edge-slide graphs and run exact breadth-first shortest-path searches from all 753 roots, covering 283128 unordered pairs and verifying the jump/slide counts, eccentricities, four-slide maximum excess and 24 extremal pairs. The Python checker additionally verifies 24 explicit automorphisms and transitivity on the 24 exceptional pairs. No sampling, timing-based impossibility inference, or infinite generalization is used.

value.rationale: The unique quartic girth-five cage is a natural minimal regular sparse network with nontransitive vertex geometry. Full minimum-PMU classification and sharp, optimum-preserving physical relocation distances are meaningful complete finite invariants, not arbitrary parameters. Exactly 24 symmetric maximum-penalty pairs exhibit a precise four-slide locality obstruction even though every optimum remains reachable, making a reproducible benchmark of monitoring robustness and mobility. No downstream general theorem is claimed.
